Dear Mr. Brown,

Welcome to **[Company Name]** ! We are delighted to have you join our team. Your skills and enthusiasm will be a valuable addition, and we look forward to supporting you as you begin this exciting new chapter.

  - Meeting with your team lead
  - IT orientation and system access setup
  - Benefits overview (if not yet completed)
- **What to Bring:** A government-issued photo ID for verification (if not already provided).

**Training & Onboarding Plan**
Your first week will include:
- Company culture and values orientation
- Mandatory compliance training modules (details will be provided on Day 1)
- Introduction to your team and key partners

Throughout Weeks 2–4, you will engage in role-specific training and integration activities. Your team lead will share the detailed schedule.

Please reach out directly to:
- **HR Manager:** [Name] – for any HR-related questions

Looking forward to welcoming you on [Start Date]!

Best regards,

HR Team  
[Company Name]
